payload.summary: The Licensing committee's own index of its meetings, going back to June 2014. It is where a resident would look to check what happens next. It shows the committee met on 4 December 2025, 5 March 2026 and 8 June 2026, and is due to meet on 17 September and 3 December 2026 and on 4 March 2027, and it lists the councillors on the committee with their attendance rates.
